findings: WebDAV lazy loader avoids eager runtime dependency evaluation; availability checks require createClient function. Build shim/mobile compatibility still unverified. Constructor/fromMount not executed in controls.

list catches client/iteration failures, logs and returns accumulated files/folders without completeness marker. Original method with503 failure returns empty arrays. Combined with prior scanner this can look like empty directory; main caller reporting not yet read.
stat catches all failures as null and exists catches all as false;503 indistinguishable from absence in these return values (control). No content identity or exhaustive traversal proof.

append only treats explicit404 as missing;503 propagates and no putFileContents call occurs (control). Read-modify-write uses overwrite without ETag/version compare, so concurrent writers need caller-side policy. No remote writes executed.

readBinary slices Buffer backing array using byteOffset/byteLength, preserving view boundaries in original control. Assumes binary response exposes Buffer-like fields; real client/browser representation untested.

mkdir ignores all per-component errors, not only already-exists, potentially resolving despite failure. remove/rename/copy delegate directly; read-only enforcement belongs to callers and remains unverified. None invoked.

List derives each child from basename only; no explicit dedup, special-entry guard or canonical parent relationship check. Client listing semantics unverified. Paths normalize backslashes only, content untouched.

Two read upstream test files cover lazy loading/availability/build-shim source regex and append success/404/503 with mocks. They do not qualify live WebDAV completeness or concurrency; full Vitest not run.

executed_controls.method: Original adapter method bodies after Node type stripping; prototype instance with synthetic client, original normalizePath mock and stubbed loader/log/credential imports. No constructor/credentials/network/remote storage actions.

limits: 25/129trackedblobs read; full plugin/main caller behavior unverified.
